title: Dimension-free Q2 influence transfer on heterogeneous zero-field Ising trees
question: Can a bounded degree-two function retain a dimension-free Var²/max-coordinate-influence guarantee under genuine overlapping coordinate dependence?
mechanism: unique overlap orientation of pair paths

theorem.law: finite tree V; signed finite J_e; nu(x)=2^(-|V|) prod_edges(1+t_e*x_u*x_v); t_e=tanh(J_e)
theorem.f: algebraic degree<=2 in original physical spin variables, |f|<=B on full cube
theorem.budgets: S=max_u sum_v prod_{e in path(u,v)} |t_e|; D=max_u(1+sum_{e incident u} |t_e|/(1-|t_e|)); H=max_u sum_{e incident u} atanh|t_e|
theorem.conclusion: Var_nu(f)^2 <= K0 * S^4 * D * cosh(H)^2 * B^2 * max_i I_i
theorem.K0: existing finite uniform-independent-product Q2 coefficient, e.g. (2(1+sqrt(2))*sqrt(3)+11901/6250)^2
theorem.dimension_free_when: S,D,H are uniformly bounded across the finite tree family

comparison.old: whole-law density ratio b^2/a, exponential in chain length for fixed nonzero coupling
comparison.new: dimension-free under weighted path summability, bounded precision and conditional uncertainty budgets
comparison.no_claim: constant is not shown optimal; prior-art priority unresolved

exact_checks.scope: 150 finite models; 675 coordinate comparisons; six sharp witnesses
4 tree shapes and 8 configurations, geodesic overlap identity
4 heterogeneous signed-coupling finite trees; 32 quadratic polynomials

proof_attack_targets: unique geodesic endpoint orientation and no double counting
native single-coordinate conditional variance vs product reference
exact inverse precision matrix including zero edges
distinguish algebraic degree<=2 from dependent Hoeffding degree
independent_audit.largest_gap: full pinned Lean terminal / external formal proof review / exact prior-art implications

source_credit: NIGHTFALL finite Q2 sources and independent collaborators
limitations: finite trees/forests; cycles not covered by bond factorization
real finite couplings; no infinite-volume limit established here
not a novel-priority or published claim
cheapest_next_test: Lean-certify weighted-path covariance row bound and exact inverse precision matrix before composing the full terminal
